audit.comparability: same WASM-3.0 toolchain and production pipeline; actor subtractions remain directional by contract
audit.verdict: NO-BUILD — SQL PREMIUM IS CURRENTLY JUSTIFIED
implementation_blockers: no broad removable owner conservatively clears 32768 final raw bytes
typed actor is planner-free and is not a matched SQL control
narrowing supported SQL behavior would add a runtime mode or remove functionality

findings.title: The direct typed comparison overstates removable SQL overhead
findings.evidence: Final SQL minus typed is 1169634 bytes, but typed calls planner-free Database::get. SQL minus the closer dynamic structural-query actor is 315217 bytes; that control has four additional measurement exports and remains directional.
findings.impact: The maintained structural planner and executor must not be classified as SQL frontend bloat.

findings.title: Entity routing and cache-miss compilation parse the same SQL separately
findings.evidence: Trusted query ingress fully parses for entity selection before cache lookup and parses again on a compile-cache miss. Diagnostic facade attribution can add a third parse. The focused cold matrix counted 21936 to 42079 instructions for the cache-miss parse; routing parse cost is currently outside reported compile and total values.
findings.impact: Every cache hit still pays a full routing parse, misses repeat parsing, and SQL phase totals omit real frontend work.
constraints: reuse one parsed statement through the existing owner chain
do not introduce an AST cache, runtime mode, execution route or parallel authority
measure true total instructions before claiming a saving
